title: Fix missing homepage text update by updating all remaining occurrences (including HTML metadata)

requirements.text: Identify and update any remaining user-facing occurrences of the old phrase "Get Leader-Giotag" (and any other outdated variants of the homepage headline) so that the application consistently shows the intended updated wording where applicable.

quotes: I still can't see updated text Dispite of check on 10 devices, please fix this

acceptanceCriteria: A codebase-wide check confirms there are no remaining user-facing strings containing "Get Leader-Giotag" (including in HTML metadata, React components, and translation strings).

Where the app previously displayed the old phrase, it now displays the updated wording as specified in REQ-3/REQ-4 (or a deliberate, explicitly preserved alternative if it is not the same UI element).

requirements.text: Update the homepage section headline in frontend/src/components/RecentReports.tsx to display exactly: "Report by clicking Photo & GPS leader image, Certificate, Complaint & Legal Notice" (and ensure no other code path can override it on the homepage).

quotes: I still can't see updated text Dispite of check on 10 devices, please fix this

acceptanceCriteria: On the route "/" (home page), the visible H2 headline above the recent reports section matches exactly: "Report by clicking Photo & GPS leader image, Certificate, Complaint & Legal Notice".
There is no alternate rendering (e.g., conditional language mode, duplicated component, or fallback UI) that shows a different headline on the homepage.

requirements.text: Update the document title and social/share metadata in frontend/index.html to remove the old wording and use the updated wording consistently (update <title>, og:title, and twitter:title).

quotes: I still can't see updated text Dispite of check on 10 devices, please fix this

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html <title> no longer contains "Get Leader-Giotag" and uses the updated wording.
frontend/index.html meta property="og:title" no longer contains "Get Leader-Giotag" and uses the updated wording.
frontend/index.html meta name="twitter:title" no longer contains "Get Leader-Giotag" and uses the updated wording.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep backend unchanged (single-actor Motoko architecture; no schema/state migration needed for this request).
Use English for any user-facing text changed/added by this request.
nonGoals: Adding new features unrelated to the missing text update.
Changing layout/styling beyond what is necessary to ensure the correct text is displayed.
